dialogue.text: Pins are the main collectible around these parts.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text: Most commonly you get obtain pins by buying boxes on the other half of the counter.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text: Some might have more specific requirements to unlock, so check your pin board for a hint on how to obtain one.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text: You kind of just collect them for the sake of it. They don't do anything.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text: Making an individual pin do something specific would go against the reason for their existance!
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia
